profile.headline: engineering @ guild.ai
profile.summary:
I build production infrastructure for AI agents, with a focus on the runtimes, execution systems, and evaluation layers that make them reliable at scale.

My work spans agent orchestration, tool-use and retrieval pipelines, state and context management, observability, and automated evaluation. I’m especially interested in the systems challenges behind long-running and multi-step agents: coordinating asynchronous work, managing failures, enforcing correctness, and maintaining low-latency execution across models, tools, and services.

I bring a PhD in Statistics and a systems-oriented engineering background, combining rigorous evaluation with pragmatic architecture. I’m most effective in ambiguous environments where the problem is not simply improving a model, but designing the infrastructure that allows intelligent systems to operate safely, efficiently, and predictably in production.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Built 0 to 1 agentic AI workflows for business verification, KYB, and compliance automation.
- Developed LLM-driven decision pipelines with evaluation, calibration, quality gates, and human-in-the-loop review for high-stakes operational workflows.

positions.title: Full-Stack Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Built synthetic labeling pipelines for sparse fraud typologies, expanding training coverage for rare risk classes and improving downstream model performance. 
- Trained risk relevance models for financial crime workflows, using weak supervision, machine labeling, and new criminality features to improve precision/recall and reduce false positives. 
- Developed relevance and entity-resolution systems over structured and unstructured risk data, including TF-IDF/logistic regression models, calibrated scoring pipelines, and multilingual entity matching.

positions.title: PhD Researcher - Bayesian Statistics
positions.description: - Contributed methodology and theory for variational inference, scalable Bayesian inference, and MCMC.
